Markets.summary: The Nifty recently fell below its 200-week moving average of 22,606, marking the first time this long-term average has been breached since March 2020. As a result, the 22,600 level is expected to be a critical zone for the market in the upcoming days.

Data & Insights.summary: India's forex reserves dropped by a record $18.34 billion to $747.56 billion during the week ending September 25. The decline occurred as the Reserve Bank of India intervened to support the rupee.
